title: Utility Types
description: Learn built-in TypeScript utility types for common transformations.

data.text: **Utility types** are built-in TypeScript types that transform other types. They're incredibly useful for common type operations.

data.title: Exercise: Build a Form State Utility
data.description: Create a utility type for form state from an input interface.
steps: Define a FormInput interface with username, email, and password
Create a FormValues type using Partial<FormInput>
Create a FormErrors type with the same keys but string values
Create a FormTouched type tracking which fields were touched
data.expectedOutcome: A set of utility types that model form state cleanly.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Utility types save time and improve type safety.
